correctness.rationale: For the final path-only claim R(z)=(z²−6z+12)/(z²+6z+12) is in (0,1] on the nonnegative real axis and equals 1 at zero. This proves positive definiteness, symmetry and row sums, but not off-diagonal signs. Projection on the explicit orthogonal P2/P3 modes gives the positive formulas for all t=ch>0, with identity at h=0. For fixed n,c, each positive eigenvalue contributes 1−12/(h lambda)+O(h^-2); summing the finite spectral projectors gives I−12 L^dagger/h+O(h^-2). Independently solved the zero-mean endpoint column by fluxes c(u_i−u_{i+1})=(n−1−i)/n from Lu=e0−1/n. Summing the differences yields u1=(n−1)(2n−7)/(6nc), strictly positive for n>=4. This proves eventual failure at the stated neighbor for each such order. The new repairs/2/verify.py ran successfully: nine constrained Laplacian coefficients, ten exact small-path matrices, seven large-step sign witnesses. Inspected but did not run the submitted script. The excised cycle claim was not removed for a scientific error: resistance centering on d(n−d)/(nc) gives the stated adjacent leading coefficient, and independent integer polynomial multiplication of the proposed C5 circulant numerator by the normalized Padé denominator matches the scalar denominator times the Padé numerator in all five distance positions.

value.rationale: The repaired exact criterion answers the all-timestep monotonicity question on a standard homogeneous reflecting path for every order. Earlier knowledge of safe small paths and the P4 boundary did not determine behavior on each larger path.
